correctionToOwnCP1Draft.whatCP1Assumed: Read the setbacksFactServeCutover.ts / zoningFactServeCutover.ts header comments ('no live legacy loader -- the legacy value is whatever the Tier-1 bake already wrote') as meaning both rails' baked legacy values pass through to the customer identically whenever the cutover doesn't apply, i.e. both present-reachable.
correctionToOwnCP1Draft.whatVerificationFound: The two rails diverge. brokerageNodeFacets.ts:625-640 defines stripZombieEnvelopeFromFacets, which the SHARED loadBakedNodeFacetSnapshot() (brokerageNodeFacets.ts:651-699, used by BOTH live routes per its own doc comment 'shared pure-read path for the public facet endpoint and paid Property Explorer reports') calls UNCONDITIONALLY on every snapshot read (line 691), setting `envelope: null` regardless of allowlist/cutover state. computeTier1Envelope's output -- including the `setbacks` sub-field of Tier1EnvelopeFacet -- lives inside `facets.envelope`, which this function deletes before any response leaves either route. The function's own comment: 'Land-use / zoning / baseFacts stay; envelope is atom-path only.' Zoning (`facets.zoning`) and cadRoll (`facets.baseFacts.*`) are explicitly exempted and DO pass through -- verified separately for zoning via attachVerdictLayersToFacets (structuralFactToFacetsWire.ts:229-255), which leaves `out.zoning` untouched when no parcel_record zoning fact is supplied, i.e. the baked value surfaces as-is.
correctionToOwnCP1Draft.bypassCheck: Grepped every other consumer of the `placeLayerSnapshots` table (brokerageSiteContext.ts, operatorRunState.ts, warmingHarness.ts, brokeragePlace.ts) -- none selects payloadJson/facets; brokeragePlace.ts only reads latRounded/lngRounded. loadBakedNodeFacetSnapshot is the sole path any live route uses to expose snapshot facets, and it always strips envelope. No bypass exists.
correctionToOwnCP1Draft.revisedVerdict: setbackFrontFt's legacy value (computeTier1Envelope's bake-time output) is PRESENT in storage (written into place_layer_snapshots at bake time; the bake CLI still runs) but UNREACHABLE by any live customer request through either of the two serve routes in this repo -- independently confirmed by two separate facts that would each be sufficient alone: (1) the computation itself is vacuous (both branches decline, never populates `setbacks`), and (2) the serve-side strip discards `facets.envelope` unconditionally before every response, with no code path bypassing it. This is a DIFFERENT verdict than zoningDistrict, which shares the same header-comment language ('no live legacy loader') but whose baked value is NOT stripped and DOES reach customers. Reported as a correction rather than silently fixed in CP1, per DEV_PROCESS 1.4 (two things that look identical from a header comment and aren't is a free finding, not a rounding error) and 4.1 (verify at source, not at the comment).
